home.title: Rithmomachia
home.intro: Move the numbers. Make the sequence. Learn a game where pieces meet through arithmetic, then build a line that wins by progression.
home.signature: Move the numbers. Make the sequence.
home.editionNote: A modern digital edition of the common medieval and Renaissance rules family.

learn.title: Learn the numbers
learn.intro: Practice each movement shape, arithmetic capture, reserve, and ending with the game’s real rules engine.

reason.stalemate: The player with no legal action loses.
reason.elimination: All opposing men and kings were captured.
reason.repetition: The same position occurred for the third time.
reason.abandon: A player did not reconnect in time.
reason.agreement: Both players agreed to a draw.
reason.progression: Three equally spaced values formed an arithmetic progression.

play.drawOffered: Draw offered. Make your move; your opponent can accept or decline.

setup.title: Set up a game
setup.intro: Choose a bounded bot or share the board with someone beside you.
setup.botHint: Six fixed-budget strengths, from beginner to master.
setup.localHint: Take turns on the same board and device.
setup.blackNote: Black moves first in this edition.
setup.localPassNote: Black moves first. Pass the device after each turn. The game saves on this device, so you can return later.
setup.firstTurn: Black moves first. If you choose White, the bot makes the opening move.

online.quickHint: Find an opponent in the same time-control pool.
online.invalidCode: Enter a valid six-character room code.
online.notFound: That room could not be found.
online.serverError: Online play is unavailable right now. Check your connection and try again.
online.shareHint: Share this code or link with your opponent.
online.qrAlt: QR code for the room invite link
online.opponentDisconnected: Your opponent has {{seconds}} seconds to reconnect.

novice.name: Novice
novice.description: A gentle first opponent that often leaves a useful line open.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.description: Finds simple moves and learns to protect valuable numbers.

arithmetician.name: Arithmetician
arithmetician.description: Looks for equal values and short arithmetic captures.

strategist.name: Strategist
strategist.description: Plans captures and watches for a progression line.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: Searches several replies and guards the pyramid.

master.name: Master
master.description: The strongest fixed-budget opponent in this edition.

notebook.title: Position notebook
notebook.prompt: Its shape sets its reach. Its number sets the arithmetic of a capture.
notebook.ruleSource: This edition follows the selected common medieval and Renaissance rules family.

movement.circle: One diagonal square in any direction.
movement.triangle: Exactly two clear squares along a rank or file.
movement.square: Exactly three clear squares along a rank or file.
movement.pyramid: Move by any surviving component shape; the face shows its current total.
